verdict.rationale: Department-scoped access is a fair question for an FP&A planning tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents role- or department-scoped permissions that let a budget owner see and edit only their own numbers. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: read-only report links for investors and boards, separate workspaces per client for advisors, and per-tool allow/ask/deny policies for agent actions.

support.subject: As a finance lead, department-scoped permissions let a budget owner see and edit their numbers without exposing the whole company
